summary: @servicetitan/tokens preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package advertises itself as a ServiceTitan design-tokens library (fonts/CSS) but its package.json preinstall script runs `node setup.mjs`, an obfuscated launcher that downloads a Bun runtime binary from a GitHub releases URL into a temporary directory, unzips and chmods it executable, and then uses that alternate runtime to execute the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated blob (rotated string-array decoder `WV8StW` over table `n7gIxM`, hex-named identifiers, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header) with no design-token content. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: an obfuscated payload of unknown behavior is executed on the installer's machine at `npm install` time under a runtime other than Node, giving arbitrary code execution on install and evading Node-focused install-time inspection. The delivery pipeline itself (obfuscated launcher + fetched second runtime + obfuscated 727KB payload mismatched to the package's stated purpose) is inconsistent with any legitimate function of a design-tokens package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
